rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a container holding liquid or another substance.

example.english: This vessel is used to hold soup.
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 jung4 hei3 jung6 lei4 zong1 di1 tong1

rows.note: Use this when the vessel carries blood in an animal, rather than referring to a plant vessel or another fluid channel.

example.jyutping: nei1 tiu4 hyut3 gun2 bei2 hyut3 jik6 lau4 gwo3

rows.note: Use this technical term for a plant vessel that conducts water or sap.

example.english: A plant vessel carries water up to the leaves.
example.traditional: 植物入面嘅導管會將水分送上葉面。
example.jyutping: zik6 mat6 jap6 min6 ge3 dou6 gun2 wui5 zoeng1 seoi2 fan6 sung3 soeng5 jip6 min6

rows.note: Use this specifically for a lymph vessel, not a blood vessel.

example.english: This lymph vessel is used to transport lymph fluid.
example.traditional: 呢條淋巴管係用嚟運送淋巴液嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 lam4 baa1 gun2 hai6 jung6 lei4 wan6 sung3 lam4 baa1 jik6 ge3
